<!-- nativecmpkit-resolution:NAV-017:20261027-original-acceptance -->
## Verified resolution — original NAV-017 acceptance

**Root cause:** Both showcase share actions opened a dialog falsely claiming a clipboard operation that never happened.

**Repair:** The demonstration explicitly reports "This is an action preview. No link was copied or shared." Both original taps remain preview-only; no hidden clipboard or native sharing was added.

**Affected implementation:** [`sample/common/src/commonMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.sample/screens/ShowcaseScreen.kt`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/8ab82a3fa41caad34cd7fb7a2d3722bfc25e3838/sample/common/src/commonMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.sample/screens/ShowcaseScreen.kt) — both share actions / showShareDialog result.

### Original required checks reviewed
- **Assert the dialog text is truthful for the chosen demonstration behavior.** — passed-source-guard.
- **If copy is implemented, verify clipboard content from one explicit user tap on each supported platform.** — not-applicable-conditional.

[Verbatim original-requirement/source/Git/XML review](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/8ab82a3fa41caad34cd7fb7a2d3722bfc25e3838/docs/development/evidence/closure-review-20261027-001/lead-original-acceptance-review.json) at immutable evidence commit `8ab82a3fa41caad34cd7fb7a2d3722bfc25e3838`. The six current source-contract guards pass. This issue concerns the illustrative sample claim, not proof of native library sharing; the original clipboard test is conditional and inapplicable because copying is not implemented. 

[Current staged preflight](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/8ab82a3fa41caad34cd7fb7a2d3722bfc25e3838/docs/development/evidence/ci-preflight-20261027-019/lead-review.json) passes23/23 commands,1,137 overlapping Python executions, strict documentation/actionlint and both whitespace checks; it executes zero new library/native/packaged methods.

**Compatibility / limits:** Sample text only; no unimplemented clipboard side effect implied. Original issue description, labels, upstream discussion and previous remaining notes are preserved. This closes only the original specific defect after required-scope review; minimum-platform/device/native-stack integration, whole-library API/ABI, full packaged consumers, dependency trust, legal/native-payload and all other issue/release gates remain independent and are not waived. No package, release, deployment or Pages publication.
